description: This script contains functions to modify boot configuration and prepare for system upgrades on an ASRock device, interacting with MTD partitions and UBI volumes.

methods.name: asrock_bootconfig_mangle
methods.description: Modifies the partition table to indicate the system upgrade mode or bootcheck status by editing specific bytes in the bootconfig MTD partition.

methods.name: asrock_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for an upgrade by setting the boot configuration and removing certain UBI volumes.
